parameters.name: ids
parameters.description: Filters records by ID. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,). A maximum of 200 IDs are supported.

parameters.name: includeSystemRecords
parameters.description: Specifies whether to include system built-in records.

parameters.name: jsonFilterAcc
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable JSON filter acceleration.

parameters.name: jsonPath
parameters.description: The JSON field path. Use this parameter together with jsonPathValue.

parameters.name: jsonPathValue
parameters.description: The filter value of the JSON field. Use this parameter together with jsonPath.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The start position of the query.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Searches for the specified string in record content.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: The maximum number of records to return. Valid values: 1 to 200.
